snippet.title: Tiny Patisserie - Combine and Box Up Sweet Treats - Gameplay Teaser (Steam)
snippet.description:
Run your own cozy pastry shop. 🍰 Spot what customers are craving, combine and box up sweet treats, and jump into hands-on minigames for every order. Unlock new recipes, upgrade your tools, and grow your tiny shop into a thriving neighborhood favorite.

Don't forget to wishlist to get an email when we release a free demo! https://store.steampowered.com/app/4703250/Tiny_Patisserie/
